messages:
maya: Prod eu-west1 is seeing a spike of 503s on /v1/embeds for short payloads. Found a tokenizer edge-case with lone 0x00 bytes. I have a hotfix image that sanitizes inputs. Need expedited path: staging smoke then prod in ~20m. @igor @zoe please ack.
deploy-bot: Policy check: service=embeds requires canary. Override allowed with 2 ENG + 1 SRE approvals.
igor: What's the rollback plan if staging shows regression?
maya: Rollback to redwood/embed:v2.6.0 (current). No DB changes. Hotfix image: redwood/embed:v2.6.1-sanitize-174777.
zoe: I'll run staging smoke and targeted short-payload probe.
tom: Any infra/secret changes?
maya: None — image only, no config flags.
release-coordinator: Heads-up: I need a 1-line release note before prod rollout if you want me to publish at completion.
zoe: staging smoke running (./scripts/smoke_embeds_short.sh --region eu-west1). TTL ~2m.
zoe: staging smoke PASS. no 5xx in 3m, kv warmed.
igor: +1 after smoke. :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: +1 from SRE. I'll set alert and run synthetic hits. Auto-rollback threshold set: eu-west1 5xx > 1% for 2m.
maya: Triggering expedite and pin. command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.6.1-sanitize-174777 --target staging --pin --override-canary --notes "hotfix: sanitize lone null byte in tokenizer; no DB"```
deploy-bot:  Override flag detected. Approval log: maya/igor/zoe/oncall-sre. Scheduling staging deploy.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy started -> staging. sha=1a2b3c. healthcheck=smoke-sigs, timeout=3m.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded in 45s. No 5xx in 3m min-monitor window.
maya: Rolling to prod now (fast path). command: ```/deploy --service embeds --image redwood/embed:v2.6.1-sanitize-174777 --target prod --pin --rollout 100% --notes "expedite: tokenizer sanitize hotfix"```
deploy-bot: Prod rollout started. Auto-rollback if eu-west1 5xx > 1% sustained for 2m.
oncall-sre: Monitoring live. Synthetic short-payload OK. I'll open an incident if any regression.
release-coordinator: Draft release note: "embeds: fix 503s caused by lone null-byte in tokenizer; no schema changes." Link: https://docs.internal/releases/174777-sanitize-draft
deploy-bot: Prod rollout completed to 100%. No rollback triggered.
zoe: Nice work, smooth.
igor: Thanks all for quick thumbs.
maya: Thanks team. I'll publish release note and keep a 45m watch. Closing thread unless anything pops up.
